主要内容: Imperial Capital Bancorp, Inc. filed a voluntary petition under Chapter 11 of Title 11 of the United States Code in the United States Bankruptcy Court, Southern District of California, Case No. 09-19431-LA11. The Company and Holdco Advisors L.P. filed a proposed plan of reorganization with the Bankruptcy Court. On May 24, 2012, the Bankruptcy Court confirmed the Plan, which will become effective in June 2012 upon satisfaction of conditions. The Plan cancels all outstanding common stock and expects no assets will remain for distribution to shareholders after unsecured creditors are paid. A Form 15 will be filed to deregister the stock under the Exchange Act. On May 31, 2012, Imperial Capital Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K, which included a monthly operating report from April 2012. The report indicated that as of April 30, 2012, the company had total assets of $37.3 million and total liabilities of $99.8 million. The filing also included forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties. The report included Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, which confirmed the Second Amended Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization.
